## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm spell`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm test` pass

- [ ] The rebuilt hook bundle is included, if this change affects it
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private project details in code, tests, or screenshots
